in_marathi.name: Anushri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anushri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anushri is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anushrīt' meaning 'graceful' or 'pleasing'. In Hindu mythology, Anushri is the name of a celestial nymph or 'Apsara' who is known for her enchanting beauty and alluring charm. She is often depicted as a graceful dancer, captivating hearts with her mesmerizing movements and captivating aura.
